changelog:
Initial release of 热点提醒器 (Hot Topics Alert System):

- Monitor specified keywords across major Chinese platforms (Weibo, Zhihu, Baidu, etc.) for trending status.
- Get real-time alerts with platform info and popularity metrics when your keyword trends.
- Manage monitored keywords: add, view, and remove easily.
- Alerts include actionable hints to maximize exposure.
summary: 热点提醒器 | Hot Topics Alert System. 监控关键词上热搜，自动提醒 | Monitor keywords trending, auto alert when topic hits hot list. 触发词：热点提醒、热搜监控、关键词监控.
